releases.name: Project Brain v1 and Platform Intelligence Registry
releases.summary: Added a runtime Project Brain service, visible subsystem versions, stronger diagnostics, event waiting contracts and generic decision rule evaluation.

releases.name: Platform Doctor Version Contract Hotfix
releases.summary: Made the Platform Doctor version display manifest-driven and aligned Project Brain subsystem metadata with the active platform manifest.

releases.name: Decision Audit and Event Contracts
releases.summary: Added durable decision explanations, event contracts, audit history and permanent regression tests for release identity.

releases.name: Subsystem Registry Consistency Hotfix
releases.summary: Introduced a central Subsystem Registry as the sole source of truth for subsystem names and versions, with permanent consistency checks.

releases.name: Platform Metadata Consistency Hotfix
releases.summary: Completed the registry-driven subsystem inventory and introduced automated manifest coverage and UI visibility consistency checks.

releases.name: Repository Intelligence Foundation
releases.summary: Introduced a canonical repository inventory, runtime repository service, critical-file integrity checks and registry-driven subsystem visibility.

releases.name: Content Intelligence Foundation
releases.summary: Introduces a canonical content registry, content relationships, lifecycle statuses and validation as a reusable platform subsystem.

releases.name: Release Identity Quality Gate Hotfix
releases.summary: Aligned Worker and manifest identity, added readiness retries and introduced an executable release quality gate.

releases.name: AI Knowledge Graph Foundation
releases.summary: Introduced a typed semantic graph, graph query service, integrity diagnostics and release quality checks.

releases.name: Asset Intelligence Foundation
releases.summary: Introduced a canonical asset intelligence registry, issue detection, impact analysis and reusable runtime services.
